title: Add Bubble Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: No open design questions — Bubble is Scatter plus one additional quantitative size channel. The symbol mark, x/y scales, and series-based grouping already exist in scatterSpecBuilder.ts/scatterMarkUtils.ts; the only new logic is a size scale (sqrt range for area-accurate radius), which is a standard Vega scale type with no novel behavior to design.

summary: A scatter-derived mark that maps a quantitative size field to an area-accurate symbol radius via a sqrt scale. Reuses Scatter's x/y/series encoding and grow-in enter animation; adds only the size scale/encoding.
requirements: Accepts x, y, and a required quantitative size channel, plus an optional series channel for grouping/coloring points (same as Scatter's series channel, not a color channel)
Size channel drives symbol radius via a sqrt scale so encoded area (not radius) is linearly proportional to the data value
Reuses Scatter's grow-in point enter animation
Stroke color matches fill color per point (no separate stroke styling)
Legend shown only when the series channel is present, same rule as Scatter

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Render the existing EmptyState, matching Scatter's current empty-data behavior.
Render one bubble sized by the sqrt scale's domain-to-range mapping; scale domain degenerates to a single value, so radius should fall back to the scale's minimum range value.

edgeCases.case: Size value of zero or negative
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Clamp to the sqrt scale's minimum radius rather than rendering a zero-radius or inverted bubble; document the clamp explicitly since sqrt of a negative number is invalid.
Same categorical overflow behavior as Scatter's existing series/color handling — no new behavior needed.
Larger bubbles should not fully occlude smaller ones for hover purposes — reuse Scatter's voronoi hover-target approach so hit-testing isn't blocked by z-order.
Fill/stroke resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware color scale, matching Scatter.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
Hover/tooltip state must key off the underlying data point, not the rendered radius, so tooltip positioning doesn't jump when bubble size varies.

crossCutting.notes: touchesHoverAnimation/touchesControlledHighlight/touchesLegendInteraction/touchesTooltipOrPopover: inherited as-is from Scatter's existing wiring (isAnimate gate, CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/SERIES, legendHighlightSignals, voronoi hover overlay + ChartTooltip/ChartPopover) — Bubble reuses scatterMarkUtils.ts's interactive-mark plumbing rather than reimplementing it. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true because a new quantitative size scale (sqrt type) must be added to setScales; no new signal is needed. requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

implementationPlan.change: Create BubbleOptions/BubbleOptionsWithDefaults/BubbleSpecOptions, extending scatterSpec.types.ts's ScatterOptions shape with a required `size` field (data field name) and a `sizeRange` (min/max radius) option with a default.
Add BubbleOptions to the MarkOptions union.
Fully-populated defaultBubbleOptions fixture, modeled on scatterTestUtils.ts's defaultScatterOptions plus the size field.
getBubbleMark, reusing scatterMarkUtils.ts's getScatterMark symbol construction and grow-in animation encode, adding a size-scale-driven `size` encode property (stroke = fill, per requirements).

addBubble, addData, addSignals (reuse scatter's interactive-mark signal helpers), setScales (reuse addContinuousDimensionScale/addMetricScale/addFieldToFacetScaleDomain for series/color, plus a new sqrt size scale), modeled on scatterSpecBuilder.ts's addScatter.
Unit tests for getBubbleMark including the size encode, using the new fixture.
Per-function tests for addData/addSignals/setScales, including a test asserting the sqrt size scale is added.
Register bubbleCount: -1 in initializeComponentCounts, import addBubble, add the 'bubble' switch case.
BubbleProps/BubbleElement, Omit-ing only fields replaced at the React boundary (children for ChartTooltip/ChartPopover, same as Scatter).
Render-null component holding prop defaults, placed under rc/ per the Donut/BigNumber rc-status precedent.

Import Bubble from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case, following the Scatter/Donut case pattern (including ChartTooltip/ChartPopover child collection reuse from scatterAdapter-style helpers).
Add Bubble to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic and WithSeries stories, following Scatter.story.tsx's structure.

openQuestions: What is the default sizeRange (min/max radius in px)? Needs a design token or a sensible default (e.g. 4–40px) confirmed before implementation.
Should size support a custom scale type override (e.g. linear) or always default to sqrt for area accuracy?
